list.title: Foreign broker research
list.intro: Structured metadata from a private library. Originals are never distributed; summaries are written independently by OsbornAlpha.
list.upsideNote: Upside = target / price at report − 1 (derived · upside/1, same currency). Ratings, targets and upside are third-party judgments (unsettled). No latest price is shown.
